last_episode_to_air.name: House of Heroes
last_episode_to_air.overview: Harriet sacrifices herself as Eddie and KT finally unlock the portal to destroy Ammut and save them all. KT says an emotional goodbye to Frobisher. Joy and Jerome have Mara's blessing, and Alfie has a special gift for Willow.

name: House of Anubis
overview: Strange things are happening at an English boarding school called House of Anubis. Popular student Joy goes missing, the school's cranky caretaker has a creepy stuffed crow and the school's attic may be haunted. When recent American transplant Nina gets thrust into the school during this time, she decides to investigate along with her new friend, Fabian, and housemates.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Welcome to Anubis House. It is at this boarding school that students begin settling in for the academic year only to find one student missing, a secret panel in the house's attic, codes leading to backroom staircases, clandestine rituals, and more!

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: It's a new term at Anubis House and Nina is glad to be back. But soon, a major new mystery unfolds - one that is infinitely more dangerous than anything they have encountered before.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The Sibuna gang returns to Anubis House and it's not long before their mystery radars begin to tick. Eddie starts having mysterious visions, a strange package arrives at the house, and a new teacher is definitely holding some dark secrets.
